Image1 wrongly shows FIVE feet: three long legs at LEFT, FRONT CENTER and RIGHT, PLUS TWO EXTRA SHORT PADS tucked behind the bell at lower-left and lower-right. Those TWO SHORT SIDE-BY-SIDE PADS are erroneous duplicates and must be ABSENT. The actual rocket from Image2 has EXACTLY FOUR feet arranged at cardinal quarter turns around its vertical axis. In this N orientation, retain the three COMPLETE LONG LEFT/FRONT/RIGHT legs and their pads; the FOURTH rear leg is ONE single central rear leg entirely PHYSICALLY OCCLUDED by the hull/bell. Therefore show EXACTLY THREE VISIBLE FOOT PADS, left, front-center and right, with NO visible tiny fourth/fifth pads beside the bell. No new strut, skid or support. Do not change to three physical legs: there are four physical cardinal legs, with the far one hidden.

Preserve same single solid CLOSED access panel (not a window), blue plate, compact rounded cream capsule and single cylindrical tank, ONE integrated graphite bell, ONE muted ochre waist band. Keep original hull height/diameter and leg lengths; do not trim, mirror or tilt the rocket or alter the panels. Orthographic30degree CAMERA ELEVATION/45degree azimuth, native2:1 ground projection, fixed upper-left screen lighting. Center of the landing-foot plane remains directly beneath hull centerline, maps to native32,32 in fixed64x48/(-32,-32).

ONE whole isolated N READY rocket on square1024x1024 genuinely transparent RGBA, generous minimum120pixel TRUE TRANSPARENT clearance on every side; include all three visible complete long foot pads and bell. No exhaust, glow, smoke, people, scenery, floor, shadow on an external ground surface, backdrop, platform, frames, magenta, colored guides, text, labels, number, logo, cargo, pod, probe or extra views. Preserve clean original alpha. Final count check: THREE VISIBLE long foot pads ONLY; one additional far leg hidden behind the hull, not two short pads peeking at both sides of the bell.
